name: Paint Dissolve
description: The second clip is painted over the first in layers of brush strokes, broad flat strokes of its colors first, then smaller and smaller ones, until the last fine strokes lay down its full detail. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: brush_size
params.description: Length of the broadest brush strokes, in frame heights

params.name: angle
params.description: Main direction of the brush strokes, in degrees

params.name: crossing
params.description: How much the direction of the strokes changes from one layer to the next

params.name: impasto
params.description: How thick the paint looks: relief and shine of the brush marks while it is wet
